_comment: Pages retrieved by hand, because the fetcher is refused and a browser is not.
See README.md in this folder for the protocol and for what this is not.
Every entry: the file as saved here, the URL it came from, the date it was
retrieved and by whom. Gated in both directions by check_manual_sources.py --
a file with no entry fails, an entry with no file fails, and a row citing a
file that is not here fails.
